text.card: A red giant 3,665 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 2.51 solar masses and 17.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,076 K at its surface.
